entry.title: Bill 192 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): Council: Bill 192, Draft 3 passes first reading & adopts FC-186 - 10/7/2026
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 19, ARTICLE 11, SECTION 19-90 OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO REAL PROPERTY TAX

Extends the requirement to appropriate residential tier-two and tier-three property tax revenue to the housing and homelessness fund until 2029; requires that monies from the fund be used to award grants that address housing and homelessness.

entry.title: Bill 190 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): Passed First Reading → Passed Second Reading
entry.content:
AMENDS ORDINANCE NO. 26-44, THE OPERATING BUDGET OF THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI FOR THE FISCAL YEAR ENDING JUNE 30, 2027

Appropriates revenues in the Federal Grants – Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act account ($1,300,000) and appropriates the same to the following Workforce Innovation and Opportunity Act 2026-2027 accounts: Administrative/Planning ($150,000), Adult Program ($500,000), Dislocated Worker Program ($250,000), and Youth Program ($400,000). Funds would be used to provide services that enhance employment opportunities, job retention, earnings, skill development and literacy.

Status: Passed First Reading → Passed Second Reading
